objective: Close Wave 3 A8: AI writeback save/forget/project update must be two-step where needed, validated before persistence, and fully audit logged without silent commits.

criteria.promise: Model output for memory/project writeback is validated before persistence; unknown fields, prompt-injected commands, malformed args and invalid kinds leave no vault state.
Project updates and memory proposals never become current until an explicit human confirmation call; discard leaves no current object and is audited.
Save writes evidence only, not committed memory; forget is preview-then-confirm and confirmed forget removes clips plus semantic passages/vectors, with audit events for preview and confirmation.

verification_gates.expected: Unsafe model output throws before vault mutation or audit pollution.
Only explicit confirm creates current committed objects; discard remains non-current and audited.

verification_gates.procedure: Run save and forget tests with a temporary Store semantic index.
verification_gates.expected: Save creates inbox evidence only; forget preview is non-mutating; confirm forget removes clips and indexed passages and records audit events.

recon_evidence: BELBrainWriteback and BELBrainWritebackTests were inspected. Most behavior is already covered; this ticket closes any remaining audit/state proof gaps for A8.
